text:
anita: Hey all — unexpected update: county placed a sibling group with us for emergency foster care starting today. I need to take leave to pick them up and manage intake next week. What paperwork do I need to keep pay/benefits and is there any short-term stipend for foster placement expenses?

emily: Huge heart for you, Anita. For foster/kinship placement we have a special leave workflow. Please submit a leave request at https://redwood.hr/leave -> select 'Foster/Kinship placement'. Attach the court/case worker placement letter when available. Redwood provides a one-time placement stipend (up to $1,200) for immediate needs — submit via expenses with subject `Foster placement stipend` and attach the placement letter.

anita: Thanks. Ill file the form. I may need 2 full days this week and then intermittent days over the next 4 weeks for appointments and school enrollment.

emily: Intermittent leave is fine — log each day in the leave form. For short-term paid time for placement logistics we can approve up to 10 business days of paid leave (policy exception) — please mark tentative dates in the form and well provisionally approve pending manager sign-off.

tom: Anita — Ill approve provisional dates. Team can cover immediate tasks. Anita, paste a short handoff and Ill arrange coverage.

anita: Hand-off: `docs: intake checklist link`, `oncall: not scheduled`, `weekly sync: client tracking`, `PRs: two small config changes` — adding more to the doc now.

emily: For school enrollment and immediate medical, you can also request EAP childcare referrals and urgent counseling support for the family. EAP contact: https://redwood.eap/ — they can help with rapid childcare and mental health resources.

anita: Is the placement stipend taxable? Any effect on W-2?

emily: The placement stipend is treated as a taxable reimbursement for payroll purposes. Payroll will include it on your paystub and W-2 as required. Submit the expense with receipts; payroll-bot will calculate withholding.

payroll-bot: Automated: Foster placement stipend requests should use expense code `FOSTER-STIPEND`. Processing occurs within one payroll cycle after approval. If you request expedited payment, mark `expedite` in the expense form.

anita: I need to ship a spare laptop and car seat to my home before pickup. Is Redwood able to cover the car seat purchase and ship a loaner laptop?

emily: Company will reimburse essential child safety equipment (car seats, travel cribs) up to $600 if tied to an emergency placement. Submit receipts to expenses with `Foster placement equipment`. For loaner laptop, open a Facilities ticket (choose `temporary equipment transfer`) at https://redwood.tools/facilities and note `case: foster-placement`. Facilities will coordinate same-day pickup or ship overnight where available.

facilities: Automated: Ticket #FAC-8344 created. Temporary equipment shipments require signed receipt upon delivery. If shipping cross-state overnight, include secure storage plan. Expect Facilities confirmation within 1 business day.

anita: Appreciate it. About benefits: can I add the kids to health insurance right away or is there a waiting period?

emily: For foster placements, dependents can be added within 30 days of placement. Use https://redwood.hr/benefits/enroll and attach the placement letter/caseworker form. If you need retroactive coverage for immediate medical care, file an urgent benefits request and tag `urgent: placement-medical`.

anita: If I'm out intermittently and take unpaid days after the paid window, what happens to 401k deductions and employer match?

emily: While you're on paid company leave, payroll deductions and employer 401k match continue as normal. If you go into unpaid status, employee deferrals pause; employer match pauses too. Payroll provides a schedule once leave days are finalized.

tom: For coverage, I can redistribute PR reviews and take the weekly sync. @talent if we need a 4-week contractor to help with intake triage and config changes, what's typical lead time?

talent: We can source a 4-week contractor from the short-term bench. Please submit a Backfill Request at https://redwood.hr/hiring/backfill with `duration=4_weeks` and essential skills. Bench placements typically 5-7 business days. For urgent coverage we can prioritize if tagged `priority:placement-backfill`.

anita: One more: I'm worried about leaving sensitive device with caseworker visits. Any guidance on data protection if laptop used at foster agency?

emily: Good call. Ask IT to issue a loaner with disk encryption and minimal data sync. For any device that will leave the office, submit an IT security checklist request in the facilities ticket. Don't copy PII to the device; use VDI/remote desktop instead if possible.

anita: I'll request VDI access and a sanitized loaner.

emily: Also, if you need parking or travel reimbursement (mileage, rideshare) for pickup/appointments, keep receipts and file under `Foster travel` in the expense form. We can reimburse up to the policy caps; if you anticipate higher costs, mark `advance requested` and People Ops will coordinate an advance.

anita: Thanks, team. Filing the leave and expense now. Will DM Tom the handoff link and ping Facilities for the loaner.

emily: Sending a DM checklist now: 1) submit leave (Foster/Kinship), 2) file expense (FOSTER-STIPEND) and attach placement letter, 3) facilities ticket for loaner & car seat, 4) benefits enroll within 30 days, 5) submit backfill if needed. Tag `expedite` for payroll if you need funds immediately. We're here to help. Big support to you and the family. :heart:
